svg.aria-label: Fast walk: fts(3) without changing folders, on one volume, nothing allocated per file.; Leave folders out: Skip caches, build folders or anything else with everything inside.; Sizes like du: The bytes a file or folder really takes on disk.; Duplicates: Equal size, first megabyte, full read: very few files are read whole.; Cancelable: The search reads in the background and stops when its task is canceled.; No dependencies: Foundation and CryptoKit, Swift 6 with strict concurrency.
